findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed there was not paper towels at the hand washing sink next to the ice machine. During the inspection paper towels were brought to the hand washing sink. Ensure there is always paper towels available at every hand washing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed utensils and food debris in the hand washing sink basin by the ice machine. The PIC was educated that hand washing sinks cannot be used for purposes other than hand washing. Ensure that hand washing sinks are only used for handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment: Facility bags ice on-site from their ice machine, but is not equipped with the necessary equipment to handle ice in a sanitary manner. There is no 3 compartment sink on-site for use to wash, rinse, and sanitize the ice scoop. Facility voluntarily discarded all ice that has already been bagged, and will need to cease handling of ice until a 3 compartment sink is installed in the facility.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW. [P]

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed shell eggs stored over milk inside the cooler at the back of the store. During the inspection an employee moved the eggs onto the bottom shelf. Ensure that raw foods are always stored below any ready-to-eat foods.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Facility’s 3 compartment sink has been removed, leaving the facility with no way to wash, rinse, and sanitize their ice scoop. Facility cannot handle any food (including ice) without a 3 compartment sink. Inspector will follow up on December 22, 2025 to discuss facility’s plans moving forward. In the meantime, facility must stop handling all food (including ice).
findings.citation_text: 4-301.12(B) Manual Warewashing, Sink Compartment Requirements. (B) Sink compartments shall be large enough to accommodate immersion of the largest EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS. If EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS are too large for the WAREWASHING sink, a WAREWASHING machine or alternative EQUIPMENT as specified in (C) of this section shall be used. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed an accumulation of debris on the shelves holding drinks in the walk-in cooler. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris. Ensure that the shelves are cleaned to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Observed mop to be within mop bucket. Ensure air/drop dries. COS. This is a repeat violation since 11/16/18.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed both hand sinks blocked by items (bucket, cup, mop bucket and mop). Keep hand sinks open and accessible. COS.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: Observed no paper towels at front and employee bathroom hand sinks. Ensure to restock. COS. Repeat violation since 11/16/18.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
No Quaternary ammonia test kit. Provide a test kit.
750.830g A test kit shall be provided to test sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Observed no hot water at the handwashing sink. Hot water was provided during the inspection.
750-1030 Water under pressure at the required temperature shall be provided to all fixtures and equipment that use water.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no soap and paper towels at the handwashing sink in the kitchen and restroom. Everything was provided during the inspection.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a coat stored near the prep table and personal belongings stored on the deli slicer (that is not being used just yet) to cut food. Make sure to store personal items separate from food.
750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed the mop stored incorrectly. The mop was inverted during the inspection.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
No full time food manager. Provide a full time manager for all shifts for next year according to your risk type.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Observed no chlorine test kit for the facility. Provide a test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the mop sink not functioning. Will spot check in two weeks.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels at the handwashing sink in the food prep area. Provide paper towels.
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed multiple boxes of beverages stored on the floor of the walk in cooler. Store all food and beverages at least 6 inches above the floor while in storage.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the ice cream chest freezer to have an accumulation of ice. Remove food and defrost chest freezer to allow for a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed drinks stored on the floor of the walk in cooler. Store all food and drink items at least 6" above the floor.
750-130(b) Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Caulk/seal the coffee brew station counter top to the wall to eliminate the gaps between the wall and counter top.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a steady leak at the faucet of the 3-part sink. Repair leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Provide a hand sink in the 3-part sink room for hand washing.
750-1120(a) Lavatories shall be at least the number required by law, shall be installed according to law and shall be located to permit convenient use by all employees in food preparation areas and utensil washing areas.
750-1110(a) Toilet facilities for employees shall be provided and installed according to law, shall be conveniently located and shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Complete separation from living/sleeping area, laundry
findings.comment:
REPEAT 1x> Observed a bed and personal belongings stored in the storage room. Do not allow employees to sleep or store personal belongings in this room. Remove bed and belongings.
750-1360 There must be a complete separation of living and sleeping quarters from the establishment.  Provide a complete separation of living and sleeping quarters for the establishment.
